ddl.value: "name" IS NOT NULL OR "organization" IS NOT NULL
ddl.name: chk_name_or_org

ddl.definition: select "document"."id", "document"."user_id", "document"."client_data_id", "document"."title", "document"."description", "document"."created_at", "document"."config_id", "config"."tax_registration", "config"."currency", coalesce(sum("items_with_tax"."net_amount"),0) as "net_total", coalesce(sum("items_with_tax"."gross_amount"),0) as "gross_total" from "document" inner join "config" on "document"."config_id" = "config"."id" left join "items_with_tax" on "items_with_tax"."document_id" = "document"."id" group by "document"."id", "config"."id"
ddl.name: document_with_sum

ddl.definition: select "line_item"."id", "line_item"."document_id", "line_item"."label", "line_item"."note", "line_item"."quantity", "line_item"."unit", "line_item"."unit_cost", "line_item"."net_amount", "line_item"."order", "line_item"."user_id", "line_item"."config_id", "config"."tax_registration", ((1 + COALESCE(sum("tax"."rate") * "config"."tax_registration"::INT, 0)) * "line_item"."net_amount")::NUMERIC(19, 4) as "gross_amount" from "line_item" left join "item_tax" on "item_tax"."item_id" = "line_item"."id" left join "tax" on "item_tax"."tax_id" = "tax"."id" left join "document" on "line_item"."document_id" = "document"."id" left join "config" on "document"."config_id" = "config"."id" group by "line_item"."id", "config"."id"
ddl.name: items_with_tax
